items.claim_and_conventions: Defines a benchmark specification with separate fitting/validation/test laws, a measurable forward observation model and noise kernel, admissible states, optional numerical solver/admissibility status, deterministic or kernel-valued reconstruction rules, a nonnegative measurable loss, a declared uncertainty diagnostic, and explicit forward/adjoint/gradient/ODE/runtime budgets. It asserts no train-to-test risk transfer or algorithm ranking.

source_locators.locator: §2.1–2.3, §§3–4.2, PDF pp. 2–7; Appendix A.1, Table 9, Appendix B.7.2, PDF pp. 20–21 and 27–28.

items.claim_and_conventions: Records the five InverseBench tasks, qualitative baseline/forward-query/PDE/CFL/prior-shift observations, the 1-validation/10-test Navier–Stokes split, and the strict empirical scope. Discloses that Appendix B.1 prints a contrast-dependent total-field expression while the pinned implementation uses a fixed incident field for the linear map.

source_locators.locator: §§4.3–5, PDF pp. 8–10; Tables 3–12 and Appendices A–C, PDF pp. 20–29.

items.claim_and_conventions: Defines the implemented first-Born optical model as a real-linear map from a 128×128 real permittivity-contrast grid using fixed incident fields and sensor Green coefficients; records source-reported physical dimensions, receiver counts, noise level, and data split. It does not infer linearity from the paper’s printed contrast-dependent formula.

source_locators.locator: §4.1, PDF p. 6; Appendix B.1, PDF pp. 22–23; Table 3, PDF p. 20.

items.claim_and_conventions: Defines the fixed-operator multi-coil MRI observation y_j=PFS_jz+n_j, with complex 320×320 target, raw-data noise, fastMRI knee source, and 25,012/6/94 train/tuning/test split; linearity holds only with the stated operators fixed.

source_locators.locator: §4.1, PDF p. 7; Appendix B.2, PDF pp. 23–24; Table 4, PDF p. 20.

items.claim_and_conventions: Defines Fourier visibilities with station gains/phases and additive thermal noise, orientation-corrected closure phases, the pinned implementation’s ordered-quadruple log-amplitude ratio, flux, and the GRMHD/synthetic train/validation/test split. Makes no uniqueness or posterior-calibration claim.

source_locators.locator: §4.1, PDF p. 6; Appendix B.3, PDF pp. 24–25.

items.claim_and_conventions: Defines the acoustic pressure-wave FWI model, receiver restriction, Devito solver, mesh/time-step/source geometry, noise-free label, and 50,000/1/10 CurveFaultB train/validation/test split. CFL settings are specific to the reported solver.

source_locators.locator: §3, §4.1, PDF pp. 5–7; Appendix B.4, PDF p. 26; Table 7, PDF p. 21.

items.claim_and_conventions: Defines the periodic 2D vorticity Navier–Stokes map from initial to final vorticity, partial final-time observation, Gaussian noise, pseudo-spectral adaptive-step solver, 128×128 grid, and 10,000/1/10 train/validation/test split. No general PDE or gradient claim is asserted.

source_locators.locator: §3, §4.1, PDF pp. 5–7; Appendix B.5, PDF pp. 26–27; Tables 2 and 8, PDF pp. 5 and 21.

items.claim_and_conventions: Contrasts a same-source-family fastMRI knee held-out split with the paper’s black-hole/digit and 1–6-cell-prior versus 9-cell-source OOD diagnostics. Same dataset family is explicitly not asserted to mean equal probability laws; no risk or robustness bound is claimed.

source_locators.locator: §4.1, §4.3 and Figure 5, PDF pp. 6–10; Appendix C, PDF pp. 28–29.

items.claim_and_conventions: Applies a solver-specific FWI admissibility predicate to a candidate velocity iterate. A failed predicate produces a recorded solver/admissibility failure and no data-fit score; the source-reported step-size/CFL example supplies no exact iterate or universal threshold.

source_locators.locator: §4.3 and Figure 3, PDF pp. 8–9; Appendix B.4, PDF p. 26.
